items.title: 2nd annual Mississauga Moon and Lantern Festival
items.summary: Join us in celebrating the 2nd Annual Mississauga Moon & Lantern Festival 2026 , a vibrant community event honouring the traditional Mid-Autumn Festival , one of the most treasured cultural celebrations across many Asian communities. As part of the Ontario Asian Night Market Series 2026 , this seasonal festival brings the spirit of the harvest moon to Mississauga through captivating lantern displays, cultural performances, delicious mooncakes, diverse food vendors, unique shopping experiences, and engaging activities for all ages.
items.venue: Square One Shopping Centre, Lot P6

items.title: The Egyptian Coptic Festival
items.summary: Celebrate the rich heritage of the Coptic community through a vibrant gathering filled with history, flavour, and community spirit. This festival offers a unique opportunity to explore one of the world’s oldest cultures in a welcoming and lively setting. Enjoy authentic Egyptian cuisine, traditional music, and cultural performances that showcase centuries of heritage. Browse artisan vendors, discover handcrafted goods, and take part in activities for all ages.

items.title: Movie Night in The Square: Karate Kid
items.summary: Spend an evening in Streetsville enjoying a movie under the stars with a screening of The Karate Kid (2010) . Gather your family and friends, bring along blankets or lawn chairs, and get comfortable in the Village Square for a relaxed and entertaining night out. The movie will begin at dusk, with plenty of pre-movie activities to enjoy—so be sure to arrive early. While you’re there, treat yourself to something delicious from one of the local businesses, whether it’s ice cream, churros, funnel cake, Beavertails, or your favourite snack.

items.title: Great Outdoors Comedy Festival 2026
items.summary: Get ready for big laughs in the great outdoors Mississauga! The Great Outdoors Comedy Festival is coming to town! Celebrate a summer weekend with open-air comedy, great food-truck eats, and a festival atmosphere that’s all about good vibes and even better punchlines. With the skyline behind you and the park setting all around, it’s the perfect place to unwind and enjoy top comedians alongside standout local talent. This is a 19+ event and runs rain or shine.
items.venue: Erindale Park, Picnic Area E., 1695 Dundas St. W., Mississauga, Ontario, L5C 1E3

items.title: Tim Hortons South Side Shuffle – The 28th Annual Port Credit Blues and Jazz Festival
items.summary: The 28th Annual Tim Hortons Southside Shuffle is a non-profit, award-winning blues and jazz festival held in Port Credit, Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, September 11–13, 2026. The three-day outdoor festival features three stages at Port Credit Memorial Park, presenting 60 bands from across Canada and beyond, including over 20 local acts during its Saturday afternoon street party.

items.title: Philippine Festival Mississauga
items.summary: Experience the vibrancy of Filipino heritage through a full day of music, dance, and unforgettable flavours. This lively festival brings the spirit of the Philippines to life with performances, cultural showcases, and a welcoming atmosphere for all. Enjoy live entertainment, traditional and modern dance, and a variety of authentic Filipino cuisine. Browse local vendors, discover unique crafts, and connect with a community proud to share its culture and traditions.

items.title: Mississauga Parkinson Canada SuperWalk
items.summary: C. Saddington Park for a community event raising awareness and support for people living with Parkinson’s disease and their families. This family-friendly walk welcomes participants of all ages and abilities to come together, connect with the community, and make a difference. SuperWalk events support Parkinson Canada’s programs, services, advocacy efforts, and research initiatives. Admission is free, however, online registration prior to the event is preferred.

items.title: Mississauga Literary Festival
items.summary: Celebrate the culture of reading and writing in Mississauga. Visitors can enjoy Mississauga’s annual literary festival, featuring engaging panel discussions, interactive writing workshops, book-themed activities, local author showcases, a special keynote Author Talk, and plenty more to discover. This is a drop-in event, but registering will ensure attendees receive updates leading up to the Mississauga Literary Festival. Program details and exhibitor information will be available in mid-August.

items.title: Streetsville's 6th Annual Fall Market
items.summary: Streetsville's 6th Annual Fall Market, a vibrant event for all local residents and visitors, celebrating the autumn season! Get ready for a day of fun, live music, treats, and fantastic finds. On Saturday, September 12, 2026 , starting at 12:00 PM , we invite you to indulge in a day filled with local flavors, arts, crafts, and community spirit. Shop local vendors, enjoy music, kids' activities and free face painting from 12pm-7pm.

items.title: Author Talks with Jess Janz
items.summary: An in-person talk and book signing with Jess Janz, author of The Table Where Where We Meet.
items.venue: Noel Ryan Auditorium, Hazel McCallion Central Library

items.title: Urban Composting in the Yard
items.summary: Discover how compost can transform your garden in this practical, hands-on workshop focused on building healthy soil from the ground up.

items.title: Lecture Me! Demystifying Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: Attend free monthly lectures by UTM faculty members as they highlight their research in a fun and approachable way.
items.venue: Noel Ryan Auditorium, Hazel McCallion Central Library
